# Scan for remaining opaque phrases in titles/visible copy that differ from shared vocabulary
python3 << 'PY'
import re, pathlib
html = pathlib.Path('web/index.html').read_text()
js = pathlib.Path('web/viewer.js').read_text()

# Extract title="..." and aria-label="..." and visible text-ish
titles = re.findall(r'title="([^"]+)"', html+js)
arias = re.findall(r'aria-label="([^"]+)"', html+js)
# JS template strings that look user facing
js_strs = re.findall(r'(?:title|textContent|innerHTML|setBaselineStatus|setTopBarTraceStatus|alert)\([^)]*?[`\'"]([^`\'"]{10,})', js)

suspects = []
patterns = [
    r'\bdistance budget\b', r'\bpath shortener\b', r'\bretain\b',
    r'\balgorithm', r'\bsimplif', r'\btolerance\b', r'\bthreshold\b',
    r'\bsearch\b', r'\bthe original\b', r'\bcandidate\b', r'\banchor\b',
    r'\bLayers\b', r'\btrace\b', r'\bpts\b', r'\bcompression\b',
    r'\bMetric\b', r'\bmax error\b', r'\bfile match\b', r'\bcell size\b',
    r'\bkeep ratio\b', r'\bAllowed area\b', r'\bStill-allowed\b',
    r'\bNext landing\b', r'\bPath so far\b', r'\bOriginal path\b',
    r'\bFull result\b', r'\bSearch circle\b', r'\bCandidate region\b',
    r'\bbeing process', r'\bruled out\b', r'\bstill being\b',
    r'\bgray original\b', r'\bprefix\b', r'\bhull\b', r'\bfree.space\b',
    r'\bLSSD\b', r'\bNDJSON\b', r'\bbinary\b', r'\bepsilon\b', r'\bdelta\b',
]
for s in titles + arias:
    for p in patterns:
        if re.search(p, s, re.I):
            suspects.append((p, s[:120]))
            break

# also scan html text nodes roughly for visible labels
for m in re.finditer(r'>([^<]{2,80})<', html):
    t = m.group(1).strip()
    if not t or t.startswith('{') or 'var(' in t: continue
    for p in patterns:
        if re.search(p, t, re.I):
            suspects.append(('VIS:'+p, t[:120]))
            break

print('suspect count', len(suspects))
for p,s in suspects[:60]:
    print(f'{p} :: {s}')
PY
